protocol: Simple random sample of 50 of 253 strict errors, random.Random(42), original JSONL order. One primary manually assigned category per question; secondary issues in notes. Each SQL executed read-only against local frozen Spider SQLite. No revised headline accuracy calculated.

examples.question: For each distinct test result, find the number of students who got the result.
examples.gold_sql: SELECT test_result ,  COUNT(*) FROM Student_Tests_Taken GROUP BY test_result ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT test_result ,  count(*) FROM Student_Tests_Taken GROUP BY test_result
examples.manual_note: Пропущен ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC. Строки совпадают как мультимножества. Вопрос явно не требует сортировки, эталон её требует.

examples.question: What are the names of countains that no climber has climbed?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM mountain WHERE Mountain_ID NOT IN (SELECT Mountain_ID FROM climber)
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT Country FROM mountain WHERE Country NOT IN (SELECT Country FROM climber)
examples.manual_note: Вместо названий непройденных гор возвращает страны. В вопросе опечатка countains.

examples.question: Find id of candidates whose assessment code is "Pass"?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT candidate_id FROM candidate_assessments WHERE asessment_outcome_code = "Pass"
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT candidate_id FROM Candidate_Assessments WHERE assessment_outcome_code  =  "Pass"
examples.manual_note: Исправлена опечатка реальной схемы asessment_outcome_code на отсутствующую assessment_outcome_code.

examples.question: List the names of departments where some physicians are primarily affiliated with.
examples.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.name FROM affiliated_with AS T1 JOIN department AS T2 ON T1.department = T2.departmentid WHERE PrimaryAffiliation  =  1
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.Name FROM Department AS T1 JOIN Affiliated_With AS T2 ON T1.DepartmentID  =  T2.Department WHERE T2.PrimaryAffiliation  =  'Yes'
examples.manual_note: PrimaryAffiliation сравнивается с 'Yes' вместо числового 1.

examples.question: What is the campus fee for San Jose State University in 1996?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT campusfee FROM campuses AS T1 JOIN csu_fees AS T2 ON T1.id  =  t2.campus WHERE t1.campus  =  "San Jose State University" AND T2.year  =  1996
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT T1.CampusFee FROM csu_fees AS T1 JOIN campuses AS T2 ON T1.Campus  =  T2.Id WHERE T2.Campus  =  "San Jose State University" AND T2.Year  =  1996
examples.manual_note: Год проверяется у campuses вместо csu_fees. SQL исполняется, но не выбирает нужный год оплаты.

examples.question: Show all headquarters without a company in banking industry.
examples.gold_sql: SELECT headquarters FROM company EXCEPT SELECT headquarters FROM company WHERE main_industry  =  'Banking'
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT Headquarters FROM company WHERE Main_Industry != 'Banking'
examples.manual_note: WHERE != Banking исключает строки, но не исключает штаб-квартиры, у которых одновременно есть банковская компания. Нужна логика множеств.

examples.question: How many gas companies are there?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM company
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT Company_ID) FROM station_company
examples.manual_note: Посчитаны компании, встречающиеся в station_company, вместо всех записей company.

examples.question: What are the names of accounts with checking balances greater than the average checking balance and savings balances below the average savings balance?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM accounts AS T1 JOIN checking AS T2 ON T1.custid  =  T2.custid WHERE T2.balance  >  (SELECT avg(balance) FROM checking) INTERSECT SELECT T1.name FROM accounts AS T1 JOIN savings AS T2 ON T1.custid  =  T2.custid WHERE T2.balance  <  (SELECT avg(balance) FROM savings)
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM accounts AS T1 JOIN checking AS T2 ON T1.custid  =  T2.custid WHERE T2.balance  >  (SELECT avg(balance) FROM checking) JOIN savings AS T3 ON T1.custid  =  T3.custid WHERE T3.balance  <  (SELECT avg(balance) FROM savings)
examples.manual_note: JOIN savings размещён после WHERE. Дополнительная ошибка построения двух WHERE.

examples.question: What are each physician's employee id and department id primarily affiliated.
examples.gold_sql: SELECT physician ,  department FROM affiliated_with WHERE primaryaffiliation  =  1
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT T1.EmployeeID ,  T2.DepartmentID ,  T1.PrimaryAffiliation FROM Affiliated_With AS T1 JOIN Department AS T2 ON T1.Department  =  T2.DepartmentID
examples.manual_note: EmployeeID и DepartmentID запрашиваются у affiliated_with, где таких колонок нет. Также лишняя колонка и пропущен фильтр.

examples.question: What are the id and address of the shops which have a happy hour in May?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT t1.address ,  t1.shop_id FROM shop AS t1 JOIN happy_hour AS t2 ON t1.shop_id  =  t2.shop_id WHERE MONTH  =  'May'
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT T1.Shop_ID ,  T1.Address FROM shop AS T1 JOIN happy_hour AS T2 ON T1.Shop_ID  =  T2.Shop_ID WHERE T2.Month  =  "May"
examples.manual_note: Shop_ID и Address переставлены. Результат совпадает с эталоном после перестановки. Порядок модели соответствует формулировке id and address.

examples.question: Find the name of medication used on the patient who stays in room 111?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT T4.name FROM stay AS T1 JOIN patient AS T2 ON T1.Patient  =  T2.SSN JOIN Prescribes AS T3 ON T3.Patient  =  T2.SSN JOIN Medication AS T4 ON T3.Medication  =  T4.Code WHERE room  =  111
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT t1.Name FROM Medication AS t1 JOIN Prescribes AS t2 ON t1.Code  =  t2.Medication JOIN Stay AS t3 ON t3.StayID  =  t2.Stay JOIN Patient AS t4 ON t4.SSN  =  t3.Patient JOIN Room AS t5 ON t5.RoomNumber  =  t3.Room WHERE t5.RoomNumber  =  111
examples.manual_note: Выдумана колонка Prescribes.Stay в цепочке соединений.

examples.question: Show the result of the submission with the highest score.
examples.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Result FROM acceptance AS T1 JOIN submission AS T2 ON T1.Submission_ID  =  T2.Submission_ID ORDER BY T2.Scores DESC LIMIT 1
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT * FROM submission ORDER BY Scores DESC LIMIT 1
examples.manual_note: SELECT * из submission вместо acceptance.Result.

examples.question: How many project members were leaders or started working before '1989-04-24 23:51:54'?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Project_Staff WHERE role_code  =  'leader' OR date_from  <  '1989-04-24 23:51:54'
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM project_staff WHERE date_to  <  '1989-04-24 23:51:54' OR date_from  <  '1989-04-24 23:51:54'
examples.manual_note: Условие о роли leader заменено условием date_to. Смысл OR утрачен.

examples.question: What is the average rating and resolution of all bangla songs?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT avg(rating) ,  avg(resolution) FROM song WHERE languages  =  "bangla"
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT avg(rating) ,  avg(resolution) FROM song WHERE country  =  'Bangla'
examples.manual_note: Язык bangla ищется в country вместо languages.

examples.question: Find the number of members living in each address.
examples.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) ,  address FROM member GROUP BY address
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT Address ,  COUNT(*) FROM member GROUP BY Address
examples.manual_note: Address и COUNT(*) переставлены. Результат совпадает после перестановки. Вопрос явно не задаёт порядок полей.

examples.question: What are the song names for every song whose rating is less than the minimum rating for English songs?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT song_name FROM song WHERE rating  <   (SELECT min(rating) FROM song WHERE languages  =  'english')
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT song_name FROM song WHERE rating  <  (SELECT min(rating) FROM song WHERE languages  =  'English')
examples.manual_note: 'English' вместо реального значения 'english' при чувствительном к регистру сравнении SQLite.

examples.question: Find the id of the song that lasts the longest.
examples.gold_sql: SELECT f_id FROM files ORDER BY duration DESC LIMIT 1
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT f_id FROM song ORDER BY duration DESC LIMIT 1
examples.manual_note: duration находится в files, модель обращается к song.duration.

examples.question: Find the cell mobile number of the candidates whose assessment code is "Fail"?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT T3.cell_mobile_number FROM candidates AS T1 JOIN candidate_assessments AS T2 ON T1.candidate_id = T2.candidate_id JOIN people AS T3 ON T1.candidate_id = T3.person_id WHERE T2.asessment_outcome_code = "Fail"
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT T1.cell_mobile_number FROM People AS T1 JOIN Candidate_Assessments AS T2 ON T1.person_id  =  T2.candidate_id WHERE T2.qualification  =  "Fail"
examples.manual_note: Fail проверяется в qualification вместо asessment_outcome_code.

examples.question: What are the ids of the candidates that have an outcome code of Pass?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT candidate_id FROM candidate_assessments WHERE asessment_outcome_code = "Pass"
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT candidate_id FROM Candidate_Assessments WHERE assessment_outcome_code  =  "Pass"
examples.manual_note: Повтор ошибки исправления опечатки asessment_outcome_code. Это отдельный вопрос того же шаблона, а не независимый тип ошибки.

examples.question: Find the ids and names of members who are under age 30 or with black membership card.
examples.gold_sql: SELECT name ,  member_id FROM member WHERE Membership_card  =  'Black' OR age  <  30
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT Member_ID ,  Name FROM member WHERE Age  <  30 OR Membership_card LIKE '%black%'
examples.manual_note: Member_ID и Name переставлены. LIKE '%black%' также отличается от строгого равенства, но на этой базе после перестановки результаты совпадают. Вопрос просит ids and names.

examples.question: How many proteins are associated with an institution founded after 1880 or an institution with type "Private"?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM institution AS T1 JOIN protein AS T2 ON T1.institution_id  =  T2.institution_id WHERE T1.founded  >  1880 OR T1.type  =  'Private'
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT t1.institution_id) FROM institution AS t1 JOIN protein AS t2 ON t1.institution_id  =  t2.institution_id WHERE t1.founded  >  1880 OR t1.type  =  "Private"
examples.manual_note: Посчитаны учреждения, а требуются белки.

examples.question: Show all main industry for all companies.
examples.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT main_industry FROM company
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT Main_Industry FROM company
examples.manual_note: Пропущен DISTINCT, 10 строк вместо 3 различных отраслей. Формулировка all main industry допускает обсуждение уникальности.

examples.question: List the names of all songs that have 4 minute duration or are in English.
examples.gold_sql: SELECT T2.song_name FROM files AS T1 JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.f_id  =  T2.f_id WHERE T1.duration LIKE "4:%" UNION SELECT song_name FROM song WHERE languages  =  "english"
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT song_name FROM files AS T1 JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.f_id  =  T2.f_id WHERE duration  =  4 UNION SELECT song_name FROM song WHERE languages  =  'English'
examples.manual_note: Текстовая длительность вида 4:xx сравнивается с числом 4. Также 'English' отличается от 'english'.

examples.question: What are the top 3 artists with the largest number of songs in the language Bangla?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT T1.artist_name FROM artist AS T1 JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.artist_name  =  T2.artist_name WHERE T2.languages  =  "bangla" GROUP BY T2.artist_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 3
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT artist_name FROM song WHERE languages  =  'Bangla' GROUP BY artist_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 3
examples.manual_note: 'Bangla' вместо 'bangla'. Дополнительно отсутствует JOIN artist; первичная видимая причина пустого результата — регистр.

examples.question: Which submission received the highest score in acceptance result. Show me the result.
examples.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Result FROM acceptance AS T1 JOIN submission AS T2 ON T1.Submission_ID  =  T2.Submission_ID ORDER BY T2.Scores DESC LIMIT 1
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT T1.Author FROM submission AS T1 JOIN acceptance AS T2 ON T1.Submission_ID  =  T2.Submission_ID JOIN workshop AS T3 ON T3.Workshop_ID  =  T2.Workshop_ID ORDER BY T2.Result DESC LIMIT 1
examples.manual_note: Возвращается Author вместо Result, сортировка по Result вместо Scores. Есть лишний JOIN workshop.

examples.question: What are the maximum duration and resolution of all songs, for each language, ordered alphabetically by language?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT max(T1.duration) ,  max(T2.resolution) ,  T2.languages FROM files AS T1 JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.f_id  =  T2.f_id GROUP BY T2.languages ORDER BY T2.languages
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT max(duration) ,  max(resolution) ,  language FROM song GROUP BY language ORDER BY language
examples.manual_note: Несуществующие song.duration и language. Нужны files.duration и song.languages.

examples.question: Find the name, checking balance and savings balance of all accounts in the bank sorted by their total checking and savings balance in descending order.
examples.gold_sql: SELECT T2.balance ,  T3.balance ,  T1.name FROM accounts AS T1 JOIN checking AS T2 ON T1.custid  =  T2.custid JOIN savings AS T3 ON T1.custid  =  T3.custid ORDER BY T2.balance + T3.balance DESC
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT T1.name ,  T2.balance ,  T3.balance FROM accounts AS T1 JOIN checking AS T2 ON T1.custid  =  T2.custid JOIN savings AS T3 ON T1.custid  =  T3.custid ORDER BY T2.balance + T3.balance DESC
examples.manual_note: Имя вынесено первым вместо третьего. После перестановки совпадают строки и порядок строк. Формулировка name, checking balance and savings balance соответствует модели.

examples.question: Which patient is undergoing the most recent treatment?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT patient FROM undergoes ORDER BY dateundergoes LIMIT 1
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN STAY AS T2 ON T1.SSN  =  T2.Patient JOIN UNDERGOES AS T3 ON T2.Stay  =  T3.Stay JOIN STAY AS T4 ON T3.Stay  =  T4.Stay ORDER BY T4.StayStart DESC LIMIT 1
examples.manual_note: Несуществующие Stay.Stay в соединениях. Также имя вместо patient ID и другой критерий сортировки. Сам эталон сортирует ASC при словах most recent — спорная аннотация.

examples.question: Find the student ID and middle name for all the students with at most two enrollments.
examples.gold_sql: SELECT T1.student_id ,  T2.middle_name FROM Student_Course_Enrolment AS T1 JOIN Students AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.student_id GROUP BY T1.student_id HAVING COUNT(*)  <=  2
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT student_id ,  T1.middle_name FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Student_Course_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.student_id GROUP BY T1.student_id HAVING count(*)  <=  2
examples.manual_note: student_id не квалифицирован при JOIN двух таблиц с этой колонкой.

examples.question: What is the names of the physicians who prescribe medication Thesisin?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name FROM physician AS T1 JOIN prescribes AS T2 ON T1.employeeid = T2.physician JOIN medication AS T3 ON T3.code = T2.medication WHERE T3.name  =  "Thesisin"
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM Physician AS T1 JOIN Prescribes AS T2 ON T1.EmployeeID  =  T2.Physician JOIN Medication AS T3 ON T3.Code  =  T2.Medication WHERE T3.Name  =  "Thesisin"
examples.manual_note: Пропущен DISTINCT: одна фамилия приходит двумя строками. Вопрос просит имена врачей, уникальность требует интерпретации.

examples.question: What are the total number of domestic passengers at all London airports?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT sum(Domestic_Passengers) FROM airport WHERE Airport_Name LIKE "%London%"
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT sum(Domestic_Passengers) FROM airport WHERE Airport_Name  =  "London"
examples.manual_note: Airport_Name = London вместо поиска названий, содержащих London.

examples.question: What is the id of the longest song?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT f_id FROM files ORDER BY duration DESC LIMIT 1
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT f_id FROM song ORDER BY duration DESC LIMIT 1
examples.manual_note: Как в примере 17, duration ошибочно взят из song вместо files.

examples.question: How many proteins are associated with an institution in a building with at least 20 floors?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM institution AS T1 JOIN protein AS T2 ON T1.institution_id  =  T2.institution_id JOIN building AS T3 ON T3.building_id  =  T1.building_id WHERE T3.floors  >=  20
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM building AS T1 JOIN institution AS T2 ON T1.building_id  =  T2.building_id WHERE T1.Floors  >=  20 JOIN protein AS T3 ON T2.Institution_id  =  T3.Institution_id
examples.manual_note: JOIN protein размещён после WHERE.

examples.question: What is the count of the songs that last approximately 4 minutes?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM files WHERE duration LIKE "4:%"
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM files WHERE duration  >=  3 AND duration  <=  5
examples.manual_note: Строки длительности сравниваются с числами 3 и 5 вместо текстового шаблона 4:%.

examples.question: What are the names of the songs whose rating is below the rating of all songs in English?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT song_name FROM song WHERE rating  <   (SELECT min(rating) FROM song WHERE languages  =  'english')
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT song_name FROM song WHERE rating  <  (SELECT min(rating) FROM song WHERE language  =  'English')
examples.manual_note: Несуществующая language вместо languages. Дополнительно неверный регистр English.

examples.question: What is the campus fee of "San Francisco State University" in year 1996?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT campusfee FROM campuses AS T1 JOIN csu_fees AS T2 ON T1.id  =  t2.campus WHERE t1.campus  =  "San Francisco State University" AND T2.year  =  1996
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT T1.CampusFee FROM csu_fees AS T1 JOIN campuses AS T2 ON T1.Campus  =  T2.Id WHERE T2.Campus  =  "San Francisco State University" AND T2.Year  =  1996
examples.manual_note: Как в примере 5, год фильтруется по campuses вместо csu_fees.

examples.question: From what date and to what date do the staff work on a project that has the most staff and has staff in a leader role?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT date_from ,  date_to FROM Project_Staff WHERE project_id IN( SELECT project_id FROM Project_Staff GROUP BY project_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1 ) UNION SELECT date_from ,  date_to FROM Project_Staff WHERE role_code  =  'leader'
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT date_from ,  date_to FROM Project_Staff WHERE project_id IN (SELECT project_id FROM Project_Staff WHERE role_code  =  "Leader" GROUP BY project_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1)
examples.manual_note: Изменена логика UNION на одно вложенное условие и потеряна часть строк. Формулировка неоднозначна, значение Leader тоже неверного регистра.

examples.question: List the id of students who attended some courses?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT student_id FROM student_course_attendance
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT DISTINCT student_id FROM Student_Course_Attendance
examples.manual_note: Лишний DISTINCT: 6 уникальных student_id вместо 8 строк посещений. Вопрос о студентах допускает прочтение с устранением дублей.

examples.question: Find the physicians who are trained in a procedure that costs more than 5000.
examples.gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM physician AS T1 JOIN trained_in AS T2 ON T1.employeeid  =  T2.physician JOIN procedures AS T3 ON T3.code  =  T2.treatment WHERE T3.cost  >  5000
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.Name FROM Physician AS T1 JOIN Trained_In AS T2 ON T1.EmployeeID  =  T2.Physician JOIN Procedures AS T3 ON T2.Treatment  =  T3.Code WHERE T3.cost  >  5000
examples.manual_note: Лишний DISTINCT: 3 уникальных врача вместо 4 строк. Один врач обучен нескольким подходящим процедурам.

examples.question: List from which date and to which date these staff work: project staff of the project which hires the most staffs
examples.gold_sql: SELECT date_from ,  date_to FROM Project_Staff WHERE project_id IN( SELECT project_id FROM Project_Staff GROUP BY project_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1 ) UNION SELECT date_from ,  date_to FROM Project_Staff WHERE role_code  =  'leader'
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT T1.date_from ,  T1.date_to FROM Project_Staff AS T1 JOIN Projects AS T2 ON T1.project_id  =  T2.project_id GROUP BY T1.project_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
examples.manual_note: GROUP BY и LIMIT 1 возвращают одну произвольную пару дат вместо всех дат сотрудников. Эталон содержит дополнительный UNION leader, отсутствующий в формулировке.

examples.question: Find the name and checking balance of the account with the lowest savings balance.
examples.gold_sql: SELECT T1.name ,  T2.balance FROM accounts AS T1 JOIN checking AS T2 ON T1.custid  =  T2.custid JOIN savings AS T3 ON T1.custid  =  T3.custid ORDER BY T3.balance LIMIT 1
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT T1.name ,  T2.balance FROM ACCOUNTS AS T1 JOIN CHECKING AS T2 ON T1.custid  =  T2.custid ORDER BY T2.balance LIMIT 1
examples.manual_note: Минимизация checking.balance вместо savings.balance; JOIN savings отсутствует.

examples.question: Tell me the distinct block codes where some rooms are available.
examples.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT blockcode FROM room WHERE unavailable  =  0
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT DISTINCT blockcode FROM room WHERE unavailable = 'no'
examples.manual_note: unavailable = 'no' вместо числового 0.

examples.question: What roles did staff members play between '2003-04-19 15:06:20' and '2016-03-15 00:33:18'?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT role_code FROM Project_Staff WHERE date_from  >  '2003-04-19 15:06:20' AND date_to  <  '2016-03-15 00:33:18'
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT role_code FROM Project_Staff WHERE date_from  >= "2003-04-19 15:06:20" AND date_to  <= "2016-03-15 00:33:18"
examples.manual_note: >= и <= вместо строгих > и <. На границе есть запись. Слово between допускает включение границ; нужна проверка аннотации.

examples.question: What is the number of faculty lines in campus "Long Beach State University" in 2002?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT faculty FROM faculty AS T1 JOIN campuses AS T2 ON T1.campus  =  T2.id WHERE T1.year  =  2002 AND T2.campus  =  "Long Beach State University"
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT sum(T1.Faculty) FROM faculty AS T1 JOIN campuses AS T2 ON T1.Campus  =  T2.Id WHERE T2.Campus  =  "Long Beach State University" AND T2.Year  =  2002
examples.manual_note: Год взят из campuses вместо faculty. Лишний SUM также меняет форму запроса.

examples.question: When do all the researcher role staff start to work, and when do they stop working?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT date_from ,  date_to FROM Project_Staff WHERE role_code  =  'researcher'
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT min(date_from) ,  max(date_to) FROM Project_Staff WHERE role_code  =  "Researcher"
examples.manual_note: MIN/MAX сворачивают все даты в одну пару, хотя вопрос просит даты всех сотрудников. Также 'Researcher' вместо 'researcher'.

examples.question: What are the names and sum of checking and savings balances for accounts with savings balances higher than the average savings balance?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT T1.name ,  T2.balance + T3.balance FROM accounts AS T1 JOIN checking AS T2 ON T1.custid  =  T2.custid JOIN savings AS T3 ON T1.custid  =  T3.custid WHERE T3.balance  >  (SELECT avg(balance) FROM savings)
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT T1.name ,  sum(T2.balance) FROM ACCOUNTS AS T1 JOIN CHECKING AS T2 ON T1.custid  =  T2.custid JOIN SAVINGS AS T3 ON T1.custid  =  T3.custid WHERE T3.balance  >  (SELECT avg(balance) FROM savings) GROUP BY T1.name
examples.manual_note: SUM(checking.balance) вместо суммы checking.balance + savings.balance для счёта.

examples.question: List the project details of the projects launched by the organisation
examples.gold_sql: SELECT project_details FROM Projects WHERE organisation_id IN ( SELECT organisation_id FROM Projects GROUP BY organisation_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1 )
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT t1.project_details FROM Projects AS t1 JOIN Organisations AS t2 ON t1.organisation_id  =  t2.organisation_id WHERE t2.organisation_type  =  "Public"
examples.manual_note: Выдумано условие organisation_type = Public. Вопрос обрывается, а эталон выбирает организацию с максимальным числом проектов.

examples.question: Which physicians are trained in procedures that are more expensive than 5000?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM physician AS T1 JOIN trained_in AS T2 ON T1.employeeid  =  T2.physician JOIN procedures AS T3 ON T3.code  =  T2.treatment WHERE T3.cost  >  5000
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.Name FROM Physician AS T1 JOIN Trained_In AS T2 ON T1.EmployeeID  =  T2.Physician JOIN Procedures AS T3 ON T2.Treatment  =  T3.Code WHERE T3.cost  >  5000
examples.manual_note: Повтор случая 39 на перефразированном вопросе: лишний DISTINCT.

examples.question: How many degrees were conferred in "San Jose State University" in 2000?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT degrees FROM campuses AS T1 JOIN degrees AS T2 ON t1.id  =  t2.campus WHERE t1.campus  =  "San Jose State University" AND t2.year  =  2000
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT sum(degrees) FROM degrees AS T1 JOIN campuses AS T2 ON T1.campus  =  T2.id WHERE T2.campus  =  "San Jose State University" AND T2.year  =  2000
examples.manual_note: Год фильтруется по campuses вместо degrees. SUM не исправляет неправильный фильтр.

examples.question: What is the name and age of the pilot younger than 30 who has won the most number of times?
examples.gold_sql: SELECT t1.name ,  t1.age FROM pilot AS t1 JOIN MATCH AS t2 ON t1.pilot_id  =  t2.winning_pilot WHERE t1.age  <  30 GROUP BY t2.winning_pilot ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
examples.predicted_sql: SELECT T1.Name ,  T1.Age FROM pilot AS T1 JOIN match AS T2 ON T1.Pilot_ID  =  T2.Winning_Pilot GROUP BY T1.Pilot_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1 WHERE T1.Age  <  30
examples.manual_note: WHERE поставлен после GROUP BY, ORDER BY и LIMIT.
